system.summary: Pool of many keys. Family C (R5518 etc.): homophonic substitution, about 36 signs (numerals, crosses, letter shapes), about two signs per vowel, Italian. R5482: a code.
system.notes: Dots distinguish sign variants; the 115 key sheets of the box are 19th-century reconstructions and none was matched.

prior_solution.where: Not yet searched beyond the catalogue vetting (no published readings found, 28 Oct 2026).

conditions.human_role: The user asked to solve catalogue 1311.

solution.what: Fetched all 203 DECODE records of cart. 1598/1591 (110 letters, 93 key sheets).
Contact-sheet triage of the 133 letter pages; R5482 viewed at 150 dpi. Finding: many sign families and hands, at least one code (letter+number groups); not one cipher.
Grouped all 110 letters by sign hand on 110-dpi strips; catalogue 1311 split into 18 entries (2628-2645: 17 families + 1 miscellany of 38 singletons); 9 clear leaves excluded.
Family C (R5502-R5506, R5514, R5515, R5517, R5518): automatic sign reader (sforza1597 signreader.py v2), 16,055 glyphs, clustered to 60 and to 35 signs.
CTTS headless, period Italian corpus: 60 clusters 7.31 M vs 6.48 M shuffled (1.13); 35 clusters 7.45 M vs 6.86 M (1.09). No words.
Shuffled-token control run alongside each solve; the real tokens barely beat it.
R5518 transcribed by hand from 3x crops: 563 signs, about 36 types (v2 splits three q-like signs merged in v1).
CTTS on the hand transcription: v1 1.44, v2 1.55 against shuffled; two seeds agree on the key.
Italian phrases read: "mente adoperarme in beneficio del vostra stato", "de cio avisarme", "in ordine ... fornire de le cose necessarie", "in questo paese per carestia".
R5514 transcribed by hand from 3x crops: 1,853 cipher signs, clear passages left out.
Joint CTTS on R5518 + R5514 (2,416 signs): 17.46 M vs 8.67 M shuffled (2.01); two seeds agree.
Dictionary-word share of the decryption (4-12 letters, greedy): R5514 0.51, R5518 0.39, shuffled 0.23.
R5514 reads in stretches: "la qual cosa grandemente ... per adoperar ben del vostro stato", "a roma", "a cremona", "per persone inteligenti", "risposta ... scrito", "secreto".
R5517 transcribed by hand from 3x crops: 1,698 cipher signs.
Out-of-sample: R5517 decrypted with the key solved on R5518 + R5514 only: word share 0.40 vs 0.23 shuffled; reads "la impresa de urbino", "lo mio cancelliero", "conte Iacomo", "risposta".
Joint CTTS on R5518 + R5514 + R5517 (4,114 signs): 16.70 M vs 8.04 M shuffled (2.08); word share 0.42 / 0.48 / 0.42.

Key corrected by hand with R5517 held out: o=a, -=e, w=i, t=o, c=i; 7=q, r=b, 3=g kept against the LM. Segmentation score train -8020 -> -7704, holdout -6760 -> -6335; holdout word share 0.40 -> 0.43.

Sign re-check: "- T" and "- e" are single ligature signs (D1, E). Joint solve 2.11 vs shuffled (was 2.08); D1 = a/la helps both sets slightly; the two theta shapes were not marked consistently, so their split could not be scored.

outcome.method_basis: R5518 partly decrypted with a key recovered from the ciphertext alone (no external key); about half the text reads, not yet measured.
outcome.notes: Pool of separate ciphers; needs splitting by family as was done for cart. 1597.
